user.title: SAMDUO Nex battery
user.description: Connect to a SAMDUO Nex battery on your local network. The serial number is read from the battery. Switch 'HEMS Managed' OFF in the SAMDUO app, otherwise the battery ignores every command.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the battery
data_description.port: TCP port of the Open API (default 3335)
data_description.name: Name of the battery in Home Assistant; it also prefixes the entity ids

zeroconf_confirm.title: SAMDUO battery found
zeroconf_confirm.description: Add the {model} at {host} (serial {serial})? Switch 'HEMS Managed' OFF in the SAMDUO app before using any of the control modes.

data_description.name: Name of the battery in Home Assistant; it also prefixes the entity ids

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the battery. Check the host and port, and close the SAMDUO app: the battery answers only one connection at a time.

abort.not_supported: This SAMDUO device is not a supported battery

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the battery
data_description.port: TCP port of the Open API (default 3335)
data_description.grid_power_entity: Power at the meter in watts: positive = importing, negative = exporting. Needed for every zero-on-the-meter mode. A HomeWizard P1 or any fast-updating P1/CT sensor works.
data_description.price_entity: A sensor with today's (and tomorrow's) prices in its attributes, such as Nordpool, ENTSO-e or EnergyZero. Needed for the dynamic modes.
data_description.capacity_kwh: Used for the available/needed energy and remaining time sensors
data_description.poll_interval: How often the battery is read and the strategy runs (default 5)
data_description.keepalive_interval: How often an active setpoint is re-sent (default 30)
data_description.control_timeout: How long the battery keeps a setpoint without a refresh before it frees itself (default 90, must exceed the refresh interval)

state.discharging_nom: Discharging to zero on the meter
state.charging_nom: Charging surplus to zero on the meter

hems_blocked.title: {device_name} ignores power commands
hems_blocked.description: The battery confirms every setpoint but its measured power does not follow. This happens when 'HEMS Managed' is switched ON in the SAMDUO app: the battery then manages itself with its own P1 meter and silently ignores external commands. Switch 'HEMS Managed' OFF on the battery's device settings page in the app.

missing_grid_sensor.title: {device_name} needs a grid power sensor
missing_grid_sensor.description: The selected mode balances the battery against the meter, but no grid power sensor is configured. Open the integration options and choose the sensor that reports your P1 power in watts (positive = import, negative = export).

missing_price_sensor.title: {device_name} needs an energy price sensor
missing_price_sensor.description: The selected mode uses dynamic energy prices, but no price sensor is configured. Open the integration options and choose a Nordpool, ENTSO-e or EnergyZero price sensor.

set_failed.message: The command for {entity} did not reach the battery. Check the connection and close the SAMDUO app (the battery answers one connection at a time).

set_rejected.message: {entity} cannot be set to that value: {reason}
